main_text.head: CAP. III. De differentiis artium liberalium externarum. 21.
PROBLEMATA.
main_text.l: 1 An ars liberalis recte distribuatur in contemplatricem & operatricem? 23
2 An ars liberalis recte distribuatur in generalem & specialem? 24
3 An ars liberalis recte distribuatur in obiectivam & directivam? 25
4 An ars liberalis recte distribuatur in Philologicā, Philosophicā & Theologicam? 26
5 An quaedam artes liberales recte à Philosophis dicantur subalternae, & quae ea-rum [?]fit natura? 28
main_text.head: CAP. IV. De natura & differentiis artis liberalis internæ.
PROBLEMATA.
main_text.l: I Quid sit ars liberalis interna? 31
2 Qua requirantur ad comparandam artem liberalem internam? 32
3 Quod sit subiectum recipiens habitus intellectuales, & sic etiam artis liberalis interna? ibid.
4 Quid sentiendum sit de divisione habituum intellectualium ab Arist. lib. 6. Eth. tradita? 34
5 An sapientia & prudentia sint habitus intellectuales inter se revera oppositi? 34

page.notes: The closing word line at the lower right is cut off at the right edge, so only "Finis Tec" is legible. "fit" in problem 5 is doubtful and is marked [?]. The "30." on the heading line may be a page number or part of the heading; it is given as page_number. The list numbers "I" and "2" to "5" are kept as printed. The fragment "chnologiæ." is the end of a line from the left page and is kept as a fragment.
